facts.text: Evan expresses gratitude for his family's love and support, stating that they are always there for him.

evidence.quote: I feel really fortunate to have their never-ending love and support.
Our families give us so much joy, support, and love. They're a real blessing! I don't know what I'd do without them.

facts.text: Sam agrees with Evan, emphasizing that families are always there for them and are a blessing.

evidence.quote: We both have amazing families that are always there for us. Always a blessing.
My family has been my rock through everything. Don't know what I'd do without them.

facts.text: Evan mentions that family is everything and that they bring love, happiness, and support to their lives.

evidence.quote: Our bond just keeps getting stronger and it brings such a good feeling to our lives. Family really is everything.
Family is everything - they bring so much love and happiness. They're always there for us no matter what.

facts.text: Evan refers to his family as his rock and expresses gratitude for their presence in his life.

evidence.quote: They are our rock. We're blessed to have them.
